name: Resorts and farmhouse rentals

problems.words: Two families came on the same date because the caretaker and I both took bookings
quick_ideas: Decide that only one person confirms dates, so clashes have one source
Treat a date as booked only once the advance is in, so holds don't pile up.

workzap_build.text: one calendar for all properties, shared read-only with the caretaker, where a date confirms automatically only after the advance is logged.

problems.ask_first: How many farmhouses or chalets do you run?
problems.free_stops: The booking flow and how advances lock dates are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare every booking date written by you and the caretaker for this month, so double promised days come to light now.
Keep one booking diary in one agreed place and let one person mark dates as taken, so families stop being promised the same stay.

problems.words: The advance goes to whoever they called, and I can't track who got what
quick_ideas: Give guests one payment account for every advance, so money lands in one place
Write down every advance currently held against its date, to see what's outstanding.

workzap_build.text: an advance and deposit ledger per booking, updated automatically, showing who received each payment and what balance is due.

problems.ask_first: Do guests pay advances mostly by transfer or in cash?
problems.free_stops: Ledger fields and how payments are matched to bookings stay for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each upcoming stay beside who received its advance, so you can see which bookings have money scattered around.
Make one person update one advance list every evening from calls and messages, so each booking has a clear money trail.

problems.words: Caretaker takes cash bookings on the side
quick_ideas: Let regular enquirers know bookings are confirmed only through your number, so side bookings have no cover
Compare diesel use or meter readings with booked days once, to spot unbooked use.

workzap_build.text: a daily caretaker check-in with photo and location, matched automatically against the booking calendar so unbooked use stands out.

problems.ask_first: How often are you on site in a week?
problems.free_stops: Which signals are matched and how flags are raised is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the property after each guest checkout and note any signs of use on days with no booking, so side stays stand out.
Give one person the job of checking every arriving family's booking source at the gate, so unofficial guests are harder to wave through.

problems.words: Generator diesel bills are huge and I suspect fuel is going missing
quick_ideas: Note litres bought and generator hours for the next few bookings, to see what normal use looks like
Photograph the hour meter before and after one big event.

workzap_build.text: a diesel and generator log with photo readings that compares fuel to hours run every day and flags mismatches.

problems.ask_first: Does the generator have a working hour meter?
problems.free_stops: The fuel-per-hour checks and alert rules are set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write down generator hours at sunset and again after each occupied day, so unusual diesel use gets tied to actual stays.
Give one caretaker the job of noting every fuel arrival and generator reading in one notebook, so missing diesel has fewer hiding places.

problems.words: Pre-arrival checks for pool, power and cleaning are never done properly
quick_ideas: Ask the caretaker for a photo of the pool, power and rooms before the next guests arrive, so you see it yourself
Hand over only after those photos come in.

workzap_build.text: a pre-arrival checklist with photo proof and time stamps for every booking, sent to the owner automatically, with missed checks counted.

problems.ask_first: What has gone wrong most often when guests arrive?
problems.free_stops: The checklist items and timings stay for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the farmhouse once before the next arrival and note what was still unfinished, so the weak points in preparation show.
Give one person the pre arrival round at a fixed hour with one notebook list, so guest readiness stops being rushed and missed.

problems.words: Enquiries come on Instagram, WhatsApp and phone and I lose track
quick_ideas: Keep every enquiry in one list with the date asked for, so none slip
Go back once to everyone who asked this week and didn't book.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry tracker pulling Instagram and WhatsApp enquiries into one list with automatic follow-up reminders and a count of what converted.

problems.ask_first: Where do most enquiries come from now?
problems.free_stops: Follow-up timing and source tracking are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many open enquiries are sitting in calls, chats and notes from this week, so you see the backlog plainly.
Make one staff member copy every new enquiry into one notebook before closing time, so follow up stops slipping between places.

problems.words: Guests break things and I can't tell which group did it
quick_ideas: Have each area photographed right after check-out, before cleaning, so damage is tied to one group
Mention the security deposit in every booking confirmation.

workzap_build.text: a post-checkout inspection with photos linked automatically to each booking.

problems.ask_first: Do you take a refundable security deposit now?
problems.free_stops: The inspection checklist and how it links to deposits stay for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare the condition of rooms and outdoor areas before and after the next checkout, so damage gets linked to one stay.
Give one cleaner the job of noting broken or missing items in one checkout notebook, so disputes start from a dated record.

problems.words: I don't know if the farmhouse is profitable
quick_ideas: Put last month's bookings and every cost on one page, to see the real picture once
Separate costs that come with each booking from fixed ones like salaries.

workzap_build.text: a monthly profit view per property, pulling bookings, fuel, salaries, repairs and supplies automatically.

problems.ask_first: Is the land owned or leased?
problems.free_stops: How costs are split per booking and per property is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write last week's stays on one page with the related diesel, cleaning and staff outgoings, so the earning picture gets clearer.
Give one person the job of noting booking related spending in one notebook each day, so profit is not guessed from memory.

problems.words: Every weekend is full but weekdays are empty
quick_ideas: Think of one weekday group (school trips, corporate retreats) your place suits, since they book differently from families
Let past guests who agreed to hear from you know about weekday dates.

workzap_build.text: regular WhatsApp messages to past guests (with their permission) about weekday and off-season packages, with replies tracked.

problems.free_stops: Which groups to target and the messaging plan go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which weekday enquiries asked for meetings, school visits or day use this month, so the best fit for empty days stands out.
Give one person the job of calling back weekday enquirers at one fixed time daily, so quiet dates get regular attention.

problems.words: Staff don't turn up on Eid days, exactly when we're busiest
quick_ideas: Make the Eid roster now and get each person's confirmation, so gaps show early
Line up a backup for each key role.

workzap_build.text: a peak-day roster with automatic confirmations and reminders, showing who has and hasn't confirmed.

problems.ask_first: Which role is hardest to cover on Eid?
problems.free_stops: Roster structure and reminder timing stay for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which Eid shifts were left uncovered last time and which roles were hit hardest, so you see where busy hours collapse.
Give one supervisor the job of marking Eid arrivals in one notebook at opening time, so replacements start sooner.

never_say: Pool safety, water treatment or chemical advice; lifeguard requirements.
Advice on land use, zoning, event licences or tax.
Help with hiding cash bookings or avoiding tax.
Anything that helps organise illegal events (alcohol, gambling) in that jurisdiction.
Care or dosing advice for horses or livestock; talk to a vet.
In any drowning, shock, injury or fire, call 1122/15 (PK), 999/998/997 (UAE) or 911 (Canada) first.

sample_reply.person: Chowkidar meri gair-mojoodgi mein bookings le leta hai, advance bhi kabhi usay milta hai kabhi mujhe. Koi solution batao.
sample_reply.pi:
Bilkul, is ka hal mumkin hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, tay kar dein ke date sirf ek number se confirm hogi, taake clash ka ek hi zariya rahe.
Doosra, har advance ke liye ek hi account diya jaye, taake paisa ek jagah aaye.
Workzap is se aage ye kar sakta hai: ek calendar jo chowkidar dekh sake lekin badal na sake, aur date sirf advance darj hone par pakki ho.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
